typecheckCoverage.generalCaveat: outside hono, the assumption is not verified by the reading (the amendment says so: "a type-checker declared by the project is taken as running on the tests"). Black-box probe of build 9004563 on fixtures modelled on hono: with `"test": "tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json && vp test --run"` the three type cases are credited (right); with only `"build": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json"` whose config excludes src/**/*.test.ts, or with `"test": "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vp test --run"`, they are credited too although nothing type-checks the test file (false green); with no type-checker they read red (right). hono itself ships such a build config (tsconfig.build.json:15-18): had its test script pointed at it, the 103 cases would read green unchecked
